module: Small editor debug window (Audio menu) that plots the player vehicle's suspension sounds. Every frame it asks the vehicle (queueLuaCommand) to send sounds.getBeamSounds() back to the GE in editor_suspensionAudioDebug.beamSounds, then displays, for each wheel (front/rear, left/right), curves over 200 samples of the impulse, pitch and volume. The wheel position is inferred from the position of the beam's node id1.
notes: The position is inferred from the sign of pos.y (<0 = Front, otherwise Rear) and pos.x (<0 = Right, otherwise Left), based on the vehicle's jbeam coordinates.
The code comment states that the displayed impulse is not really stress: the naming is approximate in sounds.lua.
Nothing is displayed without a player vehicle or vdata.
The file is presented in the code as a small example app to copy before modifying.

onEditorGui.desc: Draw hook called every frame: fetches the vehicle's beam sounds, updates the histories and draws the curves per wheel.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor initialization hook: registers the window (500x200) and the menu entry in the Audio group.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the vehicle changes: clears the histories and resets the counter to 1.
